implementedClauses.behavior: Unknown/malformed routes retain their raw address on an explicit unavailable surface; no unrelated chat fallback.
Explicit missing/deleted session selection survives metadata changes; known foreign-workspace sessions are unavailable; remote aliases are retained.
Queued routes preserve complete addresses, action parameters and new-panel options until navigation becomes ready.
Unresolved session ownership never mounts ChatPage during cleared metadata; the explicit address recovers when valid scoped metadata arrives.
Deleted or rejected history workspaces release push/popstate suppression through the actual asynchronous App switch result.
Every actual PanelSlot override, including unfocused panels, checks session workspace identity before ChatPage mounts; remote workspace aliases remain valid.
Reconciliation retains explicit navigation arriving before the next frame as browser history and discards obsolete/unmounted history callbacks.
The actual StrictMode wrapper retains live history after replayed effects; synchronous restored-sidebar snapshots prevent duplicate history steps.
Source/skill reads and live events stay scoped to workspace/directory and discard obsolete callbacks. Existing retry and lazy import error recovery from main are preserved.
Skill details reload the complete scoped catalog, preserve local draft fields and focus, and update untouched fields without relying on partial watcher payloads.

Canonical panel history preserves raw commas, pipes, quotes and numeric colon suffixes; v2/json/legacy ratio links stay readable; opaque route query bytes survive normal navigation and auto-selection; unavailable compact surfaces use the content lane.
Workspace geometry restores synchronously with pending resize cancellation; storage values are finite/rounded/bounded and obsolete cross-window events reread canonical storage.

New split panels receive a positive width while preserving existing relative sizes. Legacy zero/one panel shares restore as layout metadata and recover visible widths without changing entity addresses.

reviewFindings.body:
## CodeQL / Unpinned tag for a non-immutable Action or reusable workflow

Unpinned 3rd party Action 'UI-001 Recovery' step [Uses Step](1) uses 'oven-sh/setup-bun' with ref 'v2', not a pinned commit hash

[Show more details](https://github.com/rox-one/rox-one/security/code-scanning/1031)

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce workspace mismatch in panel overrides**

When a stored/deep-linked session belongs to another workspace, this changes only the `NavigationContext` state to `unavailable`, but the rendered content does not consume that state: `PanelSlot` independently parses `entry.route` and always passes it as `navStateOverride`, and `MainContentPanel` prefers that override over the context value. Consequently, restoring or switching to a workspace while a foreign session route remains selected still mounts `ChatPage` for that session instead of the intended unavailable surface. Apply the workspace check to each panel's parsed state (or ensure the focused panel uses the checked context state).

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block foreign chats when metadata is absent**

When a workspace switch retains the previous panel route, this check only rejects it if `selectedSession` exists. Fresh evidence in the current code is that `handleSelectWorkspace` explicitly clears `sessionMetaMapAtom` in `App.tsx:2203-2206` before `NavigationContext` reconciles the panels, so the old route renders `ChatPage` with an undefined lookup and can start loading that foreign session during the intervening render. Treat unresolved session metadata as pending/unavailable during a workspace transition rather than allowing it through.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Release history suppression when workspace lookup fails**

If Back/Forward reaches an entry for a workspace that has since been deleted, `handleSwitchWorkspaceBySlug` in `App.tsx:2216-2221` finds no target and returns without changing `workspaceSlug`. No workspace-switch effect then runs to call `finishHistoryReconcile`, leaving both `suppressPushRef` and `isPopstateSwitchRef` set indefinitely; subsequent navigation stops creating history entries and a later UI workspace switch can be mistaken for that stale popstate. Only enter suppression after confirming the switch, or provide a failure path that clears these flags.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
During a workspace switch\, the workspace\-mismatch guard fails to block a retained session route whose metadata was just cleared\, letting ChatPage mount and load the previous workspace\'s session\.

In the popstate handler\, `suppressPushRef`\/`isPopstateSwitchRef` are set to `true` before confirming the target workspace exists\, so a slug for a deleted\/unknown workspace leaves both flags stuck at true forever\, silently disabling history pushes\.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fail CI when committed source hashes diverge**

This comparison is only written to the receipt and never asserted, so the recovery job remains green even when it tests a different candidate than the committed manifest. That occurs in this commit: for example, the manifest records `303be05d...` for `MainContentPanel.tsx`, while the committed file hashes to `6a49e0bb...` (and several other listed files also differ). Make this step exit nonzero on a mismatch, or update the manifest, so uploaded qualification evidence cannot silently describe an unpinned source set.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Escape preserved routes in split-panel history**

When a malformed known-prefix route containing a comma, such as `knowledge/unknown,id/x`, is opened with `newPanel`, this new fallback preserves the route verbatim. `syncUrl` then concatenates panel routes with commas, while `reconcileFromUrlParams` restores them with `panelsParam.split(',')`, so reload or Back/Forward turns this one route into multiple panels and loses the original address. Encode each panel route independently or use a structured serialization before allowing arbitrary unavailable routes into the panel stack.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
